title: Keep every file an Engram test run creates inside the repository, including scratch made by the engram binaries the tests start
outcome: Keep every file an Engram test run creates inside the repository, including scratch made by the engram binaries the tests start
acceptance: Every process a test run starts, including the engram binary started by Rust integration tests and Node scripts, places its temporary files under the repository's target/ (for example by giving the child TMP, TEMP and TMPDIR inside the run's fixture root), and the existing run audit fails if a test run leaves anything in the system temp folder or the real home
The source EOL fallback's private scratch (engram-source-eol-*) is removed reliably on Windows, or the cause of a leftover is reported; a behavioral test covers the Windows cleanup

No test reads or writes the real ~/.engram, ~/.termal or the user's real temp folder; the existing target/tmp/engram ownership in scripts/test-temp.mjs and src/test_support.rs stays the single mechanism
